ticker_news.title: Wedbush sees 15% upside left for Nasdaq, tech stocks By Investing.com - Investing.com Australia
ticker_news.description: Wedbush analysts are bullish on the tech sector, predicting a further 15% upside for the Nasdaq in 2024 driven by the AI revolution. They highlight Nvidia and Microsoft as early leaders, and expect Apple, Meta, and Google to join the party in the latter half of the year.
ticker_news.author: Sam Bougheddaa
